_comment: Illustrative shape only. Every path, code and number here is a placeholder, not a measurement.
This file is GENERATED by the auditor. A human commit that changes a number without running the
scan is a rejected commit. One file per auditor: two auditors must never share these keys, because
one careless regenerate would then launder both rules at once.

keying.duringSweep: per file, so parallel batches rewrite disjoint keys
keying.atTheEnd: one whole-tree bless, because per-file keys cannot see a violation moving between files

blessedAtCommit: the change that last lowered a number, in the same commit as the fix

hardZeroRulesHaveNoEntryHere.VENDOR_IMPORT_OUTSIDE_SEAM: absent means clean; a baseline row for a judgment-free rule stores a number for something nobody disagrees about

_droppedKeysNote: A key whose file is gone is a bug in this file, not a fact about the tree: the generator drops it, so a deletion can never hide behind a stale row.
